name: Potion of Giant Strength (Stone Giant)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Your Strength becomes 23 for 1 hour (no effect if it's already higher).
text: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 23 for 1 hour. It has no effect on you if your Strength is already 23 or higher. A sliver of stone giant fingernail floats in the clear liquid.
